verified_contracts: client input cannot choose price, total, outlet, paid state or stock identity
one current physical hold and exact held units remain governed by shared stock constraints
invoice, sales, receipt, payment, order, allocation and stock effects share one transaction
same idempotency or provider event replay is stable and changed replay conflicts
provider initiation replay does not issue a second external request and a new charge is allowed only after definitive failure
unknown payment results retain a hold and require reconciliation
late verified payment is retained without creating an unallocated sale
disabled providers fail before an order is created
operating-mode changes govern new commerce but do not invalidate verified callbacks or authorized historical milestone access
paid milestone identity cannot be reused or silently recalculated
refund reservations cannot exceed collected funds or accepted-return net value
raw PAN/CVV and provider secrets are outside the service contract
corrections_during_verification: The first focused run used the previously migrated disposable schema and exposed the new migration as unapplied there; the exact test schema was migrated and then rebuilt from empty for the final gate.

Guest cancellation originally lacked durable owner scope; owner_scope_hash was added and cancellation now requires the same server-derived scope.

The first local rollback encountered the earlier in-run migration shape after owner scope was added; the defensive empty-schema down migration and empty target local schema were rebuilt, then disposable rollback/reapply and hashes passed.
The MT-2.1 schema manifest test was extended with only the additive MT-2.7 columns; the frozen source/target baseline files remain unchanged.
